title: Alien with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- alien head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='30' ry='26' fill='#3ddc84'/>
  <!-- head highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='24' ry='19' fill='#6df0a8'/>
  <!-- left eye -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='48' rx='9' ry='11' fill='#7a3aff'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='48' rx='6' ry='7.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='39.5' cy='50' r='3' fill='#1a0a3a'/>
  <!-- left sparkle -->
  <path d='M33 43 L34.5 46 L37.5 46.5 L34.5 48.5 L35 51.5 L33 49.5 L30.5 51 L31 48 L28.5 46 L31.5 45 Z' fill='#fff6a0'/>
  <!-- right eye -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='48' rx='9' ry='11' fill='#7a3aff'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='48' rx='6' ry='7.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60.5' cy='50' r='3' fill='#1a0a3a'/>
  <!-- right sparkle -->
  <path d='M68 42 L69.5 45 L72.5 45.5 L69.5 47.5 L70 50.5 L68 48.5 L65.5 50 L66 47 L63.5 45 L66.5 44 Z' fill='#fff6a0'/>
  <!-- cheek sparkles -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='57' r='1.6' fill='#fff6a0'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='57' r='1.6' fill='#fff6a0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='36' r='1.4' fill='#fff6a0'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M42 60 Q50 66 58 60' fill='none' stroke='#1fb862' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <line x1='38' y1='23' x2='32' y2='12' stroke='#2bb86e' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='31' cy='10' r='4' fill='#ffd94a'/>
  <circle cx='29.5' cy='8.5' r='1.4' fill='#fff6a0'/>
  <line x1='62' y1='23' x2='68' y2='12' stroke='#2bb86e' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='10' r='4' fill='#ffd94a'/>
  <circle cx='67.5' cy='8.5' r='1.4' fill='#fff6a0'/>
  <!-- little body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='17' ry='12' fill='#3ddc84'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='13' ry='8' fill='#6df0a8'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <line x1='33' y1='78' x2='22' y2='70' stroke='#2bb86e' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='67' y1='78' x2='78' y2='70' stroke='#2bb86e' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='68' r='3.5' fill='#7a3aff'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='68' r='3.5' fill='#7a3aff'/>
  <!-- neck ring -->
  <rect x='40' y='70' width='20' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#ffd94a'/>
</svg>
